description: Report where a held inbound transfer is and what it is waiting on: whether it is held at PENDINGDNS, whether its DNS zone exists, how many records it holds, what the domain currently delegates to, and the next step. Use this to resume a no-downtime transfer instead of tracking that state yourself.
